name: Font_LoadHighResTexture
summary: Picks a font-texture tier from a config value and device max texture size, builds a 'font high' texture header, creates the texture object and fills its surface from a DAT file; releases everything on failure.
evidence: Calls sub_1011C5D0 (allocs header and copies aFontHigh), TexObj_CreateAndUpload, sub_1011C670 (D3DXLoadSurfaceFromFileInMemory from DAT via dword_10662DCC); tier forced to 0 if CDx caps < 0x800/0x1000; failure path calls sub_1011C810.

name: Font_ReleaseHighResTexture
summary: Destroys the texture object at +0x78 through its virtual deleting dtor, frees the header buffer at +0x7C and clears the loaded flag at +0x80.
evidence: Counterpart to sub_1011C720: same fields +120/+124/+128; called by App_Destructor and from the load function's failure path.

name: Font_IsHighResTextureLoaded
summary: Returns true when flag +0x80 is 1 and the texture object at +0x78 has a surface at +8.
evidence: Reads the same fields that sub_1011C720/sub_1011C810 manage; caller sub_1011BAE0 also calls the loader.

name: Font_DecodeNextChar
summary: Reads one character from a string cursor: a single-byte char advances 1 and returns ch-32; otherwise it advances 2 and maps the double-byte code through sub_1011C940.
evidence: Takes a char** and advances by 1 or 2 (Shift-JIS style); the -32 glyph base matches font glyph index ch-32 in sub_10120510; 15 callers in the text unit.

name: Font_AddGlyphAdvance
summary: Adds a glyph's advance width to *a2: codes 8469..8515 use cell rect width (x2-x1) from table dword_10621934, codes < 0x440 use the byte width table byte_1036C428, and others use a fixed 14.
evidence: Accumulates into the out pointer and always returns 0; uses short fields +32/+34 (cell rect) as in the font shape cells; shares callers with Font_DecodeNextChar.

name: Sjis_GetCharByteLen
summary: Returns sub_1011DA30(first byte)+1, which gives the byte length of the character at a1 (1 or 2).
evidence: Pairs with the 1/2-byte stepping in Font_DecodeNextChar; 34 callers in text code. The name assumes sub_1011DA30 is a lead-byte test, which was not verified.

name: Cell_DrawAt
summary: Binds the cell's texture (lazily looked up by its lowercased 16-char name at +50 in g_pTextureMng), writes the 4 quad vertex positions as the cell rect (shorts +192..+206) offset by (x,y) minus 0.5, then draws with the cell's stored blend parameters.
evidence: SetTexture stage 0; _strlwr and sub_1003AC80(g_pTextureMng); writes floats into the vertex array at +80 (stride 28); calls sub_1011F300 with bytes +45..+48.

name: Cell_DrawTransformed
summary: Draws a cell with each vertex's color modulated by a20 and its position transformed by a matrix argument plus (x,y). The blend mode comes from packed a21 or the cell's defaults, and the original vertex colors are restored afterwards.
evidence: Per-vertex calls to sub_101200B0 (color modulate) and sub_10028290(&matrix, vertex); then sub_1011F300 with a21&3, (a21>>2)&3, (a21>>6)&3, or sub_1011F2D0; called from sub_1011FF70.

name: Cell_DrawStretchedWrapped
summary: Sets texture addressing to WRAP, then draws the cell stretched to a given size and scale. UVs come from the texture dimensions with flip flags in byte +28, colors are modulated by a10, and addressing is restored to CLAMP afterwards.
evidence: SetTextureStageState ADDRESSU/V=1 (WRAP) at entry and 3 (CLAMP) at exit; divides by texture width/height (+36/+38); flag bits 1 and 2 swap U and V; ends in sub_1011F300 or sub_1011F2D0.

name: Cell_DrawWithDefaultBlend
summary: Calls sub_1011F300 with the cell's vertex array (+80) and its stored blend bytes +45..+48.
evidence: Single call that forwards the object's own fields.

name: Cell_DrawQuadBlended
summary: Draws the cell's 4-vertex quad as a triangle strip after mapping three PS2-GS-style alpha operands (texture/frame/zero) onto D3D SRCBLEND/DESTBLEND/BLENDOP. Unsupported combinations only log a 'cell ...' debug string.
evidence: Strings aCellTextureFrame.../aCellZeroZero... go to nullsub_13; sets ALPHABLENDENABLE, BLENDOP, SRCBLEND/DESTBLEND; CDx_DrawPrimitiveUP(5,2,this+80,28); some modes do an extra pass with the vertex colors forced to white.

name: Shape_DrawScaled
summary: Iterates the shape's cell list (count at +20), skipping the first a9 cells, and draws each cell scaled by (sx,sy), optionally centered on the shape's rect. When the scale is 1.0 it takes the unscaled fast path sub_1011FB60.
evidence: List iteration via sub_10126500/sub_10126520; calls sub_1011E980 per cell; centering uses the rect shorts +32..+38; 56 callers. The 'Shape' class comes from lookups such as 'font fontshp'.

name: Shape_DrawTransformed
summary: Iterates the shape's cell list and calls Cell_DrawTransformed on each cell with the same matrix, color and blend arguments.
evidence: Same list iteration as Shape_DrawScaled; forwards all 20 arguments to sub_1011EDE0; called by the cursor draw sub_10124EB0.

name: Color_ModulateArgb128
summary: Multiplies two ARGB colors per channel as (a*b)>>7, the PS2 convention where 128 means 1.0, and clamps each channel to 255.
evidence: Pure arithmetic on all 4 bytes with >>7 and a 255 clamp; used to tint cell vertex colors.

name: ShapeMng_Init
summary: Initializes the shape manager: clears its two font and two damage-number texture slots, sets their first-glyph thresholds to -1, clears the cached shape pointers at +44/+64, then initializes the list.
evidence: The fields cleared (+28..+60, +44, +64) are the ones used by sub_10120510/sub_10120590/sub_10120730/sub_101207B0 on dword_104E1BF8; ends with list init sub_101265D0.

name: ShapeMng_FindShape
summary: Searches the manager's list for an entry whose 16-char name at +36 matches (case-insensitive) and returns its data via sub_1011E290, or NULL.
evidence: _strnicmp(entry+36, name, 16); called with names such as aFontFontshp, aMenuDmgnum and aAncAncScro; 52 callers.

name: ShapeMng_GetFontGlyph
summary: Looks up and caches the 'font fontshp' shape, takes the cell for character a2 (index a2-32), returns its width/height (+32/+36) and passes it to sub_1011FA80.
evidence: String aFontFontshp; index computed as 4*a2-128; cache at this+44.

name: ShapeMng_BindFontTexture
summary: Lazily loads the font textures, picks texture page 0 or 1 by comparing glyph code a2 with each page's first code, and binds it with SetTexture.
evidence: Calls sub_10120660 on first use; thresholds at +36/+40, textures at +28/+32; SetTexture stage 0 with the texture object's +64 or +68 interface.

name: ShapeMng_LoadFontTextures
summary: Walks the 'font fontshp' cells in order and records up to 2 distinct texture names (looked up in g_pTextureMng) together with the first glyph code (starting at 32) that uses each.
evidence: String aFontFontshp; _strlwr/strncmp on the cell texture name at +50; sub_1003AC80(g_pTextureMng); stores into this+7.. and this+9..

name: ShapeMng_GetDmgNumGlyph
summary: Damage-number counterpart of ShapeMng_GetFontGlyph: caches the 'menu dmgnum' shape, takes the cell for digit a2 (index a2-48), returns its width/height and passes it to sub_1011FA80.
evidence: String aMenuDmgnum; index 4*a2-192 (base '0'); cache at this+64; single caller sub_10041C20.

name: ShapeMng_BindDmgNumTexture
summary: Damage-number counterpart of ShapeMng_BindFontTexture: lazily loads up to two textures and binds the one that matches code a2.
evidence: Same body as sub_10120590 but on fields +48..+60; calls sub_10120880; same caller as sub_10120730.

name: ShapeMng_LoadDmgNumTextures
summary: Walks the 'menu dmgnum' cells and records up to 2 distinct textures from g_pTextureMng together with the first code that uses each.
evidence: String aMenuDmgnum; same code as sub_10120660 but stores into this+12../this+14..

name: Cursor_Init
summary: Resets the menu cursor: clears state, centers its position on the screen rect, looks up the 'anc ancscro' shape and the cursor animation shape table, hides the hardware cursor, and sets the initial position.
evidence: String aAncAncScro; fills dword_1036E4EC via ShapeMng_FindShape; sub_10009780(g_pCDx,0) (ShowCursor off); calls sub_10124700 (SetCursorPos path) on this+4.

name: Cursor_GetHwCursorSlot
summary: Returns the word at +0xA6.
evidence: CDx sub_100097F0 calls it on dword_104E1D4C for cursor types 4/5 to pick an HCURSOR slot; Cursor_Init zeroes +166.

name: Cursor_SetPosition
summary: Stores a new cursor position (and optional value a3 at +72). In windowed or mouse mode it converts the virtual-screen position to desktop coordinates using the window rect and frame metrics, then warps the OS mouse.
evidence: GetWindowRect, GetSystemMetrics(32/33/4), SetCursorPos; scales by the screen rect dword_106218B4/B8; skipped while state byte +77 is in 3..6.

name: Cursor_Draw
summary: When visible, advances the cursor's animation frame. With a hardware cursor it sets and shows the OS cursor through CDx. Otherwise it hides it and draws the cursor shape transformed (scale matrix) at +12/+16; state 6 also draws the scroll-anchor shape.
evidence: sub_100097F0/sub_10009780 (SetCursor/ShowCursor); builds a matrix via sub_100279B0/sub_10027C20/sub_10027A60; calls Shape_DrawTransformed and Shape_DrawScaled; per-type table dword_1036E4EC.

name: Cursor_SetVisible
summary: Sets the cursor visible flag at +78. In hardware-cursor mode it shows or hides the device cursor and selects the cursor shape when becoming visible; otherwise it keeps the device cursor hidden.
evidence: sub_10009780(g_pCDx, a2) is device ShowCursor; sub_100097F0(g_pCDx, type +76, 1); the same field +78 gates Cursor_Draw.

name: Cursor_StoreScreenCenter
summary: Stores half the screen-rect width and height in fields +0x38/+0x3C.
evidence: Computes (dword_106218B8-dword_106218B4)/2 per 16-bit half; called from Cursor_Init and 4 others.

name: ChatLog_AddMessage
summary: Adds a text message to the chat log: applies a message filter, optional text conversion and a sound cue, then forwards the line to the chat windows dword_1062193C/dword_10621940 (or special handlers for modes 0x96/0x97).
evidence: Returns early if the log-disabled byte at +409680 is set; sub_100380F0 (sound) with flags 0x800000/0x400000; sub_101B7260 conversion into a 2048-byte buffer; sub_10128CE0 into the log buffers; 47 callers. The 'chat' meaning is inferred.

summary: Changes a 2-bit mode in field +92 (values 0/1/2). Depending on the mode and on whether a resolved actor handle differs from this object's handle, it first calls sub_10159420 with 1/0/4.
evidence: Called from CXiSkeletonActor_DestructorBody and many actor-related functions; uses ActorHandle_Resolve(dword_1047D600). The purpose could not be pinned down.

name: Actor_SetSlotTableEntry
summary: Stores a2 into global table dword_10578770[a1] for a1<5 and returns success.
evidence: Bounds check against 5 and a single store; called only by CXiControlActor/CXiSkeletonActor constructors.

name: MenuMng_Init
summary: Initializes the UI manager: virtual size 640x480 (+128/+130), offsets and flags cleared, pointers to the chat/log globals stored at +140..+156, then calls sub_1015D9A0.
evidence: Constants 640/480; stores &dword_1062193C and &dword_10621940 (the log windows used by ChatLog_AddMessage); shares caller sub_10165070 with Cursor_Init. The 'Menu' prefix is inferred.

name: MenuMng_OpenByName
summary: Resolves a menu/window name. If an entry exists it re-initializes and reactivates it; otherwise it allocates a new 0xD4-byte entry, names it, sets type 14 and registers it. Returns the entry.
evidence: Find-or-create by a 32-char name (sub_1015E030/sub_1015DC10); Allocator_Generic(0xD4) and sub_101172C0 ctor; 290 callers including Frame_Render. The window/menu identity is inferred.

name: MenuMng_GetUiScale
summary: Returns the X and Y UI scale as width/512 and height/448, i.e. the current UI size relative to the PS2 512x448 layout.
evidence: Constants 0.001953125 (1/512) and 0.002232143 (1/448) applied to shorts +128/+130, which MenuMng_Init sets to 640/480.

name: MenuMng_GetOffsetX
summary: Returns float +0x84, or 0 when the scene state is 64 and a2 is false.
evidence: Field cleared in MenuMng_Init; gated on *g_pSceneState==64. 'Offset' is a guess; the code is a gated getter.

name: MenuMng_GetOffsetY
summary: Returns float +0x88, or 0 when the scene state is 64 and a2 is false.
evidence: Twin of sub_10160290 for the next field.

name: Gfx_SetDefault2DStates
summary: Sets the standard 2D UI pipeline: fog off, alpha test GREATER 0, linear min / point mag filtering, WRAP addressing, stage-0 MODULATE for color and alpha, stage 1 disabled, no texture transform.
evidence: SetRenderState FOGENABLE=0, ALPHAFUNC=5, ALPHAREF=0; TSS MINFILTER=2, MAGFILTER=1, ADDRESSU/V=1, COLOROP/ALPHAOP=5 (MODULATE); stage 1 COLOROP/ALPHAOP=1; called by Frame_Render. Agrees with the provisional comment (SetRenderState/TSS).

name: Gfx_DisableFogAndAlphaBlend
summary: Turns off fog and alpha blending and resets BLENDOP to ADD.
evidence: Three SetRenderState calls: FOGENABLE=0, ALPHABLENDENABLE=0, BLENDOP=1.

name: Gfx_ApplyViewport1904
summary: Applies the global viewport g_viewport_1904 through CDx_SetViewport.
evidence: Single call CDx_SetViewport(g_pCDx, &g_viewport_1904).

name: Obj_10621944_Draw
summary: If the object has content at +12, fills its background rect, then draws +12 via sub_1019EBB0 with MAGFILTER temporarily set to linear.
evidence: sub_10163390 (rect fill); SetTextureStageState MAGFILTER=2 then 1.

name: Obj_10621944_DrawBgRect
summary: If the color at +8 is non-zero, draws the object's rect (shorts at +0) as a solid quad of that color.
evidence: Calls sub_10163400(self, self[2]) only when the color is non-zero.

name: Gfx_DrawSolidRect2D
summary: Draws a screen-space solid-color rectangle from 4 shorts (x1,y1,x2,y2) with color a2: z, fog, lighting and blending off, diffuse color only, then restores defaults.
evidence: FVF 0x44 (XYZRHW|DIFFUSE); COLOROP=2 (SELECTARG1), ARG1=0 (DIFFUSE); CDx_DrawPrimitiveUP(5 TRIANGLESTRIP, 2, verts, 20); CDx_SetDefaultRenderState and sub_101604B0 afterwards.

name: Game_DestroyGlobalObjects
summary: Deletes about 40 global singleton objects through their virtual scalar-deleting destructor (arg 1), nulls each pointer, then tears down dword_1062194C.
evidence: Repeated (*vtbl[0])(obj,1) followed by obj=0, including g_pStAvatarCoordinator; called by App_Destructor.

name: Vt10336614_Destructor
summary: Destructor that only restores vtable off_10336614 (no members to release).
evidence: Single vtable store and void return; callers sub_10167490 (likely the deleting dtor) and sub_10178070.

name: Vt10336634_Destructor
summary: Destructor: restores vtable off_10336634, then releases members via sub_10167950.
evidence: Vtable store followed by a cleanup call; callers sub_101678B0 and sub_10178070.

name: GetPtr8IfField60Set
summary: Returns this+8 if the dword at +0x60 is non-zero, else NULL.
evidence: Two-line body.

name: Dbg_DrawWireMesh
summary: On the given device, draws a wireframe of a static face table (triangles or quads indexing a vertex table) scaled by a4 and translated to position a2, as closed line strips in color a3 with lighting off.
evidence: Raw IDirect3DDevice8 vtable calls: +200 SetRenderState(137 LIGHTING,0), +244 SetTexture(0,NULL), +304 SetVertexShader(0x42 XYZ|DIFFUSE), +148 SetTransform(WORLD) from D3DXMatrixTranslation, +288 DrawPrimitiveUP(LINESTRIP, 3 or 4, stride 16).

name: Mat44_Multiply
summary: Multiplies two 4x4 float matrices (a2 * a3) into a temporary and copies the result to a1, so in-place use is safe.
evidence: Triple loop of 4x4 dot products into a local float[16], then a 16-float copy; returns a1.

name: Dbg_DrawTriangleLines
summary: Draws the 3 edges of a triangle (points a1,a2,a3) as a line list with an identity world transform, no texture, no lighting.
evidence: SetTransform(WORLD, identity); FVF 66 (XYZ|DIFFUSE); fills g_upVerts_1988 with 6 vertices; CDx_DrawPrimitiveUP(2 LINELIST, 3, ..., 16).

name: Vt10336668_Destructor
summary: Destructor: restores vtable off_10336668, then calls sub_10170CD0(this, NULL) to release members.
evidence: Vtable store plus cleanup call; callers sub_1016FC60 and sub_10178070.

name: Vt1033668C_Destructor
summary: Destructor: restores vtable off_1033668C, then releases members via sub_10174A60.
evidence: Vtable store plus cleanup call; callers sub_10171900 and sub_10178070.

name: Dbg_DrawOverheadMapMarkers
summary: Draws a 512x512 screen-space top-down plot centered at (256,256), scale 256/1400: one entity list as small triangles, a second list in another color, and the position a2 as a larger diamond.
evidence: FVF 0x144 (XYZRHW|DIFFUSE|TEX1); scale constant 0.18285714; colors 0x80800000/0x80808000/0x80008080; DrawPrimitiveUP TRIANGLELIST and TRIANGLESTRIP; no static callers. Debug use is inferred.

name: Dbg_DrawOrientedBoxes
summary: For every node in the list dword_10621A08, builds a world matrix per entry (scale, Y-axis rotation, translation) and draws a unit cube (+/-0.5 vertices) untextured and unlit; also calls the text routine sub_10086210.
evidence: Fills g_upVerts_1A18/1A68/1AB8 with +/-0.5 cube faces; Mat44_Multiply with cos/sin Y rotation; SetTransform(WORLD) per entry; FVF 66; no static callers.
